answerConcept: TreeSHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) provides mathematically exact, game-theoretic feature attribution by computing each meteorological variable's marginal contribution to shifting the model's log-odds output away from the base expected value. Positive SHAP values indicate features associated with increased predicted risk; negative SHAP values indicate features associated with reduced predicted risk. Crucially, SHAP quantifies statistical feature attribution rather than proving direct physical causation.
